description: This file defines the RolesService class, which manages role-related operations such as creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting roles within a team. It interacts with external services and handles exceptions related to role management.

classes.name: RolesService
classes.description: Service class for managing roles within teams, including creation, retrieval, update, and deletion, with integrated caching and exception handling.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Creates a new role for a specified team, handles errors related to role existence and permission validation.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Retrieves a role by ID within a team, throws if not found or mismatched.

methods.name: getTeamRoles
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of roles for a team.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Updates role details and permissions, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role from a team after validation, handles errors related to default roles and non-existence.
